frames.detail: Read the objective, identify supplies and choose your route. Native first-person view with the revised HUD.
frames.title: 01 / Campus after hours

frames.detail: A walker closes in. Create distance, then fire. The selected enemy runs its normal AI and takes damage from real weapon traces.
frames.title: 02 / First contact

frames.detail: Reception is the first power-component stop. Chapter positioning is scripted; collection uses the actual pickup interaction.
frames.title: 03 / Recover the fuse

frames.detail: Spend recovered scrap on a real upgrade. Objective and kill XP improve rank and medkit effectiveness; rewards are saved once.
frames.title: 04 / Build your survivor

frames.detail: The breaker consumes the fuse and relay. The objective and rank rewards advance from the interaction, not a fabricated timer.
frames.title: 05 / Bring the grid online

frames.detail: Speak with the survivor after restoring power. Dialogue owns input and pauses threats; the journal explains the final route.
frames.title: 06 / Shaun's escape plan

frames.detail: The brute uses a distinct health bar, slower committed attacks and a readable windup. Move out of its contact range during the attack.
frames.title: 07 / Clear the courtyard

frames.detail: The episode ends after the component, power, survivor and brute prerequisites. The debrief uses actual mission statistics.
frames.title: 08 / Extraction and debrief

method: Script-assisted native gameplay: physical movement/combat and real interaction callbacks; safe repositioning between distant chapters; other enemies temporarily held for reproducibility.
